name: Fake Phong Illumination via Normal Quantization
definition: A technique to approximate Phong illumination in volume rendering by pre-computing gradients, quantizing them to a set of N normal directions, and using a pre-calculated color map indexed by these normals.
summary: Fake Phong Illumination via Normal Quantization is a real-time volume rendering technique that pre-computes lighting into a color lookup table indexed by quantized normals to achieve speed at the cost of directional aliasing artifacts.
